text:
emily.lewis: Quick shoutout — KindredRx signed a renewal for Dedicated + approved our AWS Marketplace listing for the Redwood Private connector. Deal is ~ $420k ARR, migrated two prod clusters into a single private VPC, and enabled SSO + KMS. Huge props to @jordan, @sana.k, @julian_m and the AE team. :tada: :rocket:

dave_tan: Amazing work! Can we grab a 1-2 sentence customer quote for the PR? cc @julian_m

jordan: Nice! perf win details — after quant + prefix caching we saw ~40% lower inference cost and ~30% lower median latency for their main pipeline. Will add numbers to the case study.

sana.k: Ops runbook + migration checklist is in the docs now: https://notion.redwood/KindredRx-migration. Canary rollout went smooth, we kept 99.95% SLA during cutover.

julian_m: I'll draft a quote and loop in customer execs. Also scheduling a brief with our exec team next Wed. Need logo approval from the customer before we publish.

sam_sales: AE team closed this inside the renewal window — big credit to negotiating the dedicated uplift. Can legal confirm marketplace contract note?

marketing-bot: Created PR task #PR-4623 and added to the newsroom pipeline.

kindredrx-bot: KindredRx has approved the logo and provided a short quote: "Redwood's Dedicated solution let us scale inference while keeping PHI safe and predictable." — KindredRx Product Lead

emily.lewis: Thanks — putting a draft case study in Notion: https://notion.redwood/KindredRx-case-study-draft. Please drop any customer-facing metrics (latency, cost delta) as one-liners. Marketing: please own press release + timing. Legal: please confirm marketplace terms by EOD Tue.

dave_tan: 🎉👏

jordan: Next action: fold quant config into Redwood Optimize docs and add a cookbook recipe for healthcare inference (q4_0 + kv caching config).

sana.k: I'll prepare a short "migration notes" postmortem-lite for internal ops learnings and link it from the case study.

emily.lewis: Awesome. Also planning a small celebration — pizza lunch Friday for the teams involved. :pizza:

julian_m: Count me in. I'll finish the customer quote today and ping legal.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: case-study site -> production on 2025-01-12T14:00:00Z (task PR-4623).
